# MAQAMI Travel MCP Server

> Hosted MCP server for MAQAMI, a hotel and flight booking platform with 3M+ hotels. Agents can search live hotel rates and flights, look up cities, airports and hotel details, then send the customer a secure checkout link on book.maqami.co for the exact room or fare they chose. Endpoint: https://mcp.maqami.co/ (Streamable HTTP, no API key). Customers pay only on book.maqami.co; the server never takes payment.

Connection details:

- Endpoint: https://mcp.maqami.co/
- Transport: Streamable HTTP
- Authentication: none
- Official MCP Registry name: io.github.negm17111995/maqami-travel
- npm stdio bridge: `npx -y maqami-travel`
- Generic config: `{"mcpServers": {"maqami-travel": {"url": "https://mcp.maqami.co/"}}}`

Typical flows (the server's tools/list is authoritative):

- Hotels: post_hotels_rates (cityName + countryCode, coordinates, iataCode, hotelIds or aiSearch) → get_data_hotel → user confirmation → post_rates_prebook (offerId exactly as returned) → give the customer checkoutUrl (https://book.maqami.co/booking?prebookId=...). To find a hotel by name: get_data_hotels with hotelName and countryCode.
- Flights: get_data_flights_airports → post_flights_rates → post_flights_verify → user confirmation of the final price → give the customer checkoutUrl (https://book.maqami.co/flights/booking?offerId=...)
- Existing bookings: find a customer's hotel bookings with listBookings (email and last name used to book, both must match); pass bookingId and the email used to book to every lookup, amend and cancel tool. Only the tools in tools/list exist.
- Large responses: get_data_facilities, get_data_chains, get_data_iatacodes and get_data_cities return whole reference lists; prefer targeted tools and set limit on searches.

## Examples

- [travel-agent-examples](https://github.com/negm17111995/travel-agent-examples): runnable assistants for the OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain with LangGraph and the Vercel AI SDK, with user approval before any call that is not read-only
